mission_3.prediction: For social_1, the initial setting (Repulsion 1.50, Influence 2.50) caused the path to get stuck in an "oscillation" because it reacted from too far away. After lowering the Influence to 1.00, the path successfully generated a complete route around the person. For social_2, the initial setting (Repulsion 2.50, Influence 0.40) created a successful path. After increasing the Repulsion to 4.00, the path took a much wider detour, moving farther away from the person.
mission_3.comparison:
A*: social_2 had the most clearance (0.727 m vs 0.712 m for baseline). It spent a bit less time in personal space (1.5 s vs 1.7 s) and cost almost no extra time (46.5 s vs 46.3 s). social_1 failed with field_oscillation, so I didn't count it as an improvement.

RRT: social_2 had the most clearance (1.715 m vs 1.711 m). Personal-space time was 0 s for both. It cost a little more time (43.66 s vs 43.3 s).
mission_3.recommendation: I would keep RRT with social_2. It succeeded with 1.71 m clearance in 43.7 s. A* social_2 had only 0.73 m clearance and took 46.5 s. These trials can't tell us how the robot handles people who move, because the people here were fixed.
